item.title: Kosciusko BZA Approves Petitions For Restaurant, Condominium Unit Near Lake Tippecanoe
item.description: The Kosciusko County Board of Zoning Appeals approved petitions for a new restaurant and condominium unit south of Lake Tippecanoe during a Tuesday, Feb. 10, meeting.

item.title: Winning photos in 2025 Picture Your Watershed contest
item.description: Sunrises and sunsets, misty mornings and moon-lit nights, hungry herons, lake-loving littles and furry friends - these are just a few of the images captured by participants in The Watershed Foundation’s 2025 Picture Your Watershed photo contest.

item.title: Kosciusko BZA Approves Building Expansion For PWI
item.description: The Kosciusko County Board of Zoning Appeals approved a petition for building expansion at PWI during a board meeting on Tuesday, Feb. 10.

item.title: Karaoke Night With Chris Cage Happening Friday
item.description: The city of Warsaw Parks and Recreation Department invites the community to its first Karaoke night at Zimmer Biomet Center Lake Pavilion, 6-9 p.m. Friday, Feb. 13.

item.title: BANTER: What Can 100 Women In A Barn Accomplish In An Hour?
item.description: The energy in The Barn 1880 on a February evening was more than just festive; it was transformative.

item.title: Kosciusko County Redevelopment Commission Hears Updates From KEDCO
item.description: Kosciusko Economic Development Corporation’s Chief Executive Officer, Peggy Simmons, and Talent and Housing Manager, Jessica Hauck, gave the Kosciusko County Redevelopment Commission updates on housing, hiring and growth within the county.

item.title: Sweetwater Fort Wayne To Expand, Add 300 Jobs
item.description: The Fort Wayne Redevelopment Commission today voted to pass an Economic Development Agreement with Sweetwater to support the company’s expansion in Fort Wayne.

item.title: Syracuse Park Board Reviews Cleaning Bids
item.description: The Syracuse Park Board reviewed janitorial service proposals during its meeting Monday, Feb. 9.

item.title: Etna Green Council Provides Update On Heritage Park Trail Project
item.description: The Etna Green Town Council provided an update on the town's trail project at Heritage Park during a brief meeting on Tuesday, Feb. 10.

item.title: Wawasee School Board Approves Bond Refunding, Paraprofessional Pay Increase, Contracts
item.description: The Wawasee School Board approved a wide slate of financial, operational and instructional items during its Tuesday, Feb. 10 regular meeting, including a bond refunding expected to generate long-term savings, a $1.50 hourly pay increase for paraprofessionals and multiple consulting and program agreements.
